name: Supporting Document 4
definition: Currency control document supporting the contract registration.

SupportingDocumentIdentification.name: Supporting Document Identification
SupportingDocumentIdentification.definition: Unique and unambiguous identification of the supporting document.

OriginalRequestIdentification.name: Original Request Identification
OriginalRequestIdentification.definition: Unique identification of the original query message.

Certificate.name: Certificate
Certificate.definition: Unique identification of the certificate for which the supporting document is provided.

AccountOwner.name: Account Owner
AccountOwner.definition: Party that legally owns the cash account.

AccountServicer.name: Account Servicer
AccountServicer.definition: Party that manages the account on behalf of the account owner, that is manages the registration and booking of entries on the account, calculates balances on the account and provides information about the account.

ContractReference.name: Contract Reference
ContractReference.definition: Reference of the registered contract or the underlying contract for the supporting documents.

Entry.name: Entry
Entry.definition: Individual entry of the supporting document.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that cannot be captured in the structured elements and/or any other specific block.
